name: P204(f) KwK 39/1
description: After the German troops ended the fighting in France and took power, they also captured several Allied vehicles, including the AMD.35 Panhard light reconnaissance armoured vehicles. Thirty-four of the captured AMD.35 Panhards were converted in 1944 and fitted with either a 50 mm L/42 KwK or a 50 mm L/60 KwK, both of which had already been used in the Pz.III , or the 50 mm L/60 KwK was already installed in the Sd.Kfz.234/2 "Puma" . These were used by the German side on the Eastern and Western Fronts during the remainder of World War II to secure occupied areas. After the Allies won World War II, the remaining Pz.Sp.Wg.P204(f) continued to be used by the French . The P204(f) KwK 39/1 was introduced in Update "Hornet's Sting" . Its 50 mm L/60 KwK is an excellent weapon for a more armoured vehicle capable of operating quickly and agilely. It combines the speed and high penetration power of its 50 mm L/60 KwK. However, it has limited ammunition, so you can quickly run out of ammunition if you're not careful. Players must beware of HE grenades, ground attack aircraft, and combat aircraft because the Pz.Sp.Wg.P204(f) is a lightly armoured vehicle and therefore easy prey for them.
